lines: Pickens is getting more looks lately, averaging 10.7 targets per game over his last 3 games compared with 9.0 for the season.
He has averaged 24.7 PPR points per game over his last 3 games and has 6 total touchdowns this season.
PHI allows the 3rd-most PPR points per game to WRs, and the coach said Pickens will remain a primary focus of the passing offense.
